verdicts.summary: Serious failure reproduction lacked a safe environment and stop boundary.
Long-run alerts omitted failure, missed updates, and important completion.
Skip explanations were counted and presented as proof.
Numbers are unparsed, unscored facts and surrounding copy rejects more-is-better logic.
A later response overwrote event attribution after guidance appeared.
The talk appendix exposed best-practice lessons before the self-report.
Some pre-answer prompts taught the intended lesson.
An abandoned one-time trial could count as changed work.
Useful new learning without work change had no honest response.
Skip and no-opportunity meanings overlapped.
The duration prompt also captures task, result, and stop reason and does not score time.
A successful check that found zero problems had no clear evidence wording.
Any non-empty string was counted and labeled as proof.
Fable and other agent jargon were not explained.
The safe account and concrete stop points make the lasting-effect boundary usable.
A slow export could mark an older payload as current after state changed.
One note persisted across skip and non-skip states while silently changing meaning.

verdicts.hand_repro: DOM and live-status inspection contradicted claim
verdicts.summary: The status announces the reveal and guidance follows confirmation in reading order.
Review mode exposed duplicate finish and return actions.
Isolation guidance is bounded to parallel collision risks.
Visual review is limited to important choices, visuals, and user paths.
Input placeholder contrast was weak.

verdicts.hand_repro: three release gates plus Chromium keyboard repro
verdicts.summary: An accidental tap or arrow-key step could lock the first event answer before confirmation.
The next-step rule searched current answers but called the match a first answer.
Results hid a saved practice note or skip reason after the response type changed.
